nodes.question_en: Is a red brake warning light on, or does the brake pedal feel soft, spongy or sink towards the floor?

outcome.note_en: Do not drive. Send Fernhollow Tow & Recovery (555-0147).

default_branch.note_en: Do not drive. Send Fernhollow Tow & Recovery (555-0147).

nodes.question_en: Does the car take noticeably longer to stop than usual, or has it failed to stop when expected?

outcome.note_en: Do not drive. Send Fernhollow Tow & Recovery (555-0147).

default_branch.note_en: Do not drive. Send Fernhollow Tow & Recovery (555-0147).

nodes.question_en: What do you notice when braking: a noise, the car pulling to one side, or a shake through the pedal or steering wheel?

outcome.note_en: Brakes may be worn through. Do not drive; Fernhollow Tow & Recovery (555-0147) takes the car to Kettlewick Garage.

branches.match_en: pulls clearly to one side when braking

outcome.note_en: Braking is uneven. Do not drive; Fernhollow Tow & Recovery (555-0147) takes the car to Kettlewick Garage.

branches.match_en: light squeal only, stopping feels normal

outcome.note_en: Book a brake check at Kettlewick Garage (555-0128). Call back at once if the noise or pedal feel changes.
Put the customer through to a Fernhollow fleet technician before any further driving.

default_branch.note_en: Unclear braking complaint: do not advise driving; put the customer through to a Fernhollow fleet technician.
